senses.gloss: f. (קְלַל) name of a very lean bird, ḳallanitha.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 102b:6">Ḥull. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>בק׳</he> such is the case with the ḳ.; <he>והא ק׳ עוף טמא הוא</he> but the ḳ. is an unclean bird?; <he>כעין ק׳</he> a clean bird similar in build to the ḳ.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 20a:10">B. Bath. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ לא מסרטא</he> but the ḳ. does not scratch (and a child may play with it)!; <he>כעין ק׳</he> (a bird that does scratch, but is) similar &c.
